meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Marketing, Social, Store & External Brand Applications

role: Extend the locked product identity into acquisition and public-facing channels without turning Dấu Việt into a generic travel campaign or breaking truth/provenance rules.

brand_promise.supporting: Discovery first; depth through place, story, culture, people, time and evidence.

external_principles: Recognizable as Dấu Việt before it looks like a tourism ad.
Real place/media truth remains mandatory outside the product.
One strong story/question per asset; avoid collage overload.
Brand system is consistent, but campaign composition may be expressive.
External assets may tease understanding; they must not fabricate product capabilities, ratings, reviews or historical certainty.
Logo remains a signature, not wallpaper.

social.system: real-media focal image + restrained brand frame + short editorial hook + optional entity/time/source cue
rules: source/disclosure retained when historical/reconstructed media could be misunderstood

app_store.system: real product UI + concise benefit statement + truthful media
rules: app icon uses locked Phase 01 mark
localize copy rather than baking English-only screenshots

campaign.system: one destination/story tension + Dấu Việt identity + discovery CTA
rules: campaign effects never alter documentary meaning
provide correct logo files rather than screenshots

video.system: Place → Question → Time/Story → Evidence/Connection → Explore next
rules: captions/subtitles mandatory for spoken informational content

co_branding.system: Dấu Việt mark + partner mark separated by neutral spacing/divider; no merged hybrid symbol
rules: do not recolor/redraw Time Trace to mimic partner
partner cannot imply endorsement of historical claims without editorial basis

content_pillars.name: Place Discovery
content_pillars.hook: Why should I go / look closer?

content_pillars.name: Connections
content_pillars.hook: Who/what connects this place to the wider world?

content_pillars.name: Journey
content_pillars.hook: What route helps me understand this region?

composition.logo: preferred quiet corner/signature placement with required clearspace
composition.gold: accent for focus/trace/reveal; not large luxury-gold washes
composition.effects: subtle Time/Journey/Reveal motif permitted; no fake parchment, mystical glow or generic luxury-travel grading

copy.headline: short editorial question or meaningful statement; usually 3–10 words where language permits

localization.rule: localize message, line breaks and cultural context; do not mechanically translate baked artwork
localization.store: localized screenshot copy layers and metadata
localization.social: platform/local-market safe zones and text density adjusted without changing truth

measurement_ethics.rule: marketing optimization cannot override brand truth or accessibility
